name: tidy-turns
description: Fold a finished turn's work away so only the answer shows, with a clickable summary under it

showToolCount.title: Summary: tool call count
showToolCount.description: Show how many tool calls the turn made

showToolKinds.title: Summary: kinds of tool calls
showToolKinds.description: Show the turn's tool calls by kind, such as 3 reads and 2 edits

showSubagents.title: Summary: subagents
showSubagents.description: Show how many subagents the turn ran

showFilesChanged.title: Summary: files changed
showFilesChanged.description: Show how many files the turn changed

showSessionTools.title: Summary: session tools
showSessionTools.description: Show the turn's session tool calls, such as monitors and messages, on a row of their own

showFailures.title: Summary: failed tool calls
showFailures.description: Show how many of the turn's tool calls failed or were denied

showEndReason.title: Summary: how the turn ended
showEndReason.description: Show when a turn was interrupted, refused, or ended on an error

showTokens.title: Summary: tokens
showTokens.description: Show how many output tokens the turn used

showSkills.title: Summary: skills
showSkills.description: Show how many skills the turn loaded

showToolSearches.title: Summary: tool searches
showToolSearches.description: Show how many tool searches the turn made

showMcpCalls.title: Summary: MCP calls
showMcpCalls.description: Show how many MCP tool calls the turn made
